components.name: Vine Button
components.description: Primary and focused actions; thin gold vines grow from both ends on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-vine { display: grid; gap: 2px; justify-items: center; width: 300px; padding: 11px 28px 12px; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; color: #fbf0d6; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(36,16,10,.62), rgba(22,9,5,.74)); border: 1px solid rgba(232,191,110,.6); outline: 1px solid rgba(232,191,110,.22); outline-offset: -5px; border-radius: 1px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .4s, background .4s; } .ds-vine strong { font-size: 23px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-vine small { font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; font-style: italic; color: #e4cfa6; } .ds-vine:hover, .ds-vine:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(246,214,146,.95); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(58,26,14,.7), rgba(30,12,6,.8)); }

components.name: Hairline Button
components.css: .ds-btn { padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; color: #fbf0d6; background: rgba(38,21,13,.85); border: 1px solid rgba(232,191,110,.42); border-radius: 1px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: #e8bf6e; background: #3a1d1f; }

components.name: Story Input
components.description: Free text in the AI modes; Enter sends.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; border: 1px solid rgba(232,191,110,.45); background: #1f120c; } .ds-input textarea { flex: 1; resize: none; padding: 12px 14px; font: 19px/1.5 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; color: #fbf0d6; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #f6d48e; } .ds-input button { width: 52px; color: #e8bf6e; background: rgba(91,36,51,.45); border: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgba(232,191,110,.35); }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Umber-glass sidebar navigation; active item in wine with a gold hairline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: block; width: 200px; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; font: 17px 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; color: #e4cfa6; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-nav:hover { color: #fbf0d6; background: rgba(232,191,110,.08); } .ds-nav.active { color: #fbf0d6; background: rgba(91,36,51,.55); border-color: rgba(232,191,110,.35); }

components.name: Lamplit Card
components.description: Translucent umber panel with a single gold hairline.
components.html:
Your story

A place at the table

Find Rowan and introduce yourself.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; padding: 22px; color: #fbf0d6; background: rgba(38,21,13,.9); border: 1px solid rgba(232,191,110,.35); border-radius: 1px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 6px 0; font: 500 28px 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; } .ds-card p { font: 15px/1.5 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; color: #e4cfa6; } .ds-eyebrow { font: 600 13px 'Cormorant SC', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .2em; color: #e8bf6e; }

narrative.overview: The illustrations are the light source of the whole game; interface surfaces recede into warm umber and wine shadows, framed by hairline gold. It should feel warm, comforting, mysterious and magical, never overwhelming.

rules.name: Light has a source
rules.body: Glow and warm bloom only on light sources (lantern, candles, sunset, spells, title) and special moments. Everything else uses neutral shadow.

rules.name: Gold is jewellery
rules.body: Thin lines, small caps labels, vines, the diamond. Never fills, never paragraphs.

rules.name: No gradient text, ever
rules.body: Solid cream or ink; warmth comes from light behind, not colour inside letters.

dos: Let illustrations carry colour; keep chrome quiet.
Use the vine flourish for primary and focused actions only.
Keep story text on solid backing with AA contrast in every mode.
donts: Glow on everything, gradient text, purple/blue neon, glass cards everywhere, icon-card grids.
Animate trees, mountains, rocks, the castle or the lantern in the opening, or anything by displacing detailed pixels.
Use gold for paragraphs or wide tracking on body text.
